title: RegrowthMC
description: RegrowthMC is a crossplay community focused Minecraft server offering a survival experience with custom world generation, magical biomes, abilities and more!
body:
RegrowthMC is a crossplay community focused Minecraft server offering a survival experience with custom world generation, magical biomes, abilities and more!

## What can you do on our server?
### Biome Bees
Use magical biomes to change the world around you with colourful grass, leaf, and sky colours! Biome bee changing a biome

Skills and Abilities
Level up your skills and unlock unique abilities such as friendly mobs and growth dance!

### Pinatas
Gather items as a community and complete goals to spawn magical loot dropping pinatas. You can also earn pinata badges from participating. Giant sniffer pinata

### Claiming
Protect your home, build with friends or create a protected community shop/hangout, follow our [claiming guide](https://www.regrowthmc.net/claiming) to have the safest experience whilst playing! Don't worry though, if your land isn't claimed it is still protected by the server rules!

_There is so much more you can do on our server, build your own journey! We can't wait to see what you do on our server!_

## How to join RegrowthMC
Check out our text and video based guides on joining the server at https://www.regrowthmc.net/connect. There are guides for all major platforms and devices, if you still need help join our [Discord](https://www.regrowthmc.net/discord)!
